title: Centre Georges Pompidou
visualBrief: Centre Georges Pompidou: independent mapped 42m gallery building with exposed pale structural columns and cantilevered gerberettes, six gallery levels, west piazza diagonal glazed/red escalator tube, east blue/green/yellow services, red stair towers and roof plant. Preserve the sloping piazza, Brancusi studio, IRCAM, independent ducts and all surrounding buildings. Enduring exterior inferred from ordinary photographs, not a depiction of temporary renovation works.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Named Centre Georges Pompidou POI and building share native35184427592229/OSM way55503397. Internal+X runs south-southwest along the mapped long side, +Z points west-northwest toward the piazza. The escalator rises toward the south end as observed in the frontal west photo. World heading0; orientation is baked into east/south model coordinates. Only this independent museum record is replaced.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped main building height42m and 167.14m long side are controls. Reconstructed45m glazed core, fourteen structural stations, seven floor/roof lines, approx49m high service-tower caps, tube radius1.55m and pipe/member dimensions are picture-led approximations, not engineering measurements. Mechanical inventories, roof plant and hidden facade details are simplified; furnished galleries, working escalators, copied lettering and event artwork omitted.
